Press-hold: width 18→23px with x at 13px (far edge anchored), release back to 18/18. prefers-reduced-motion emulated: x only {18,0}, no wobble, no stretch. 0 page errors.

gaps: Phase 2 (wired, 2026-09-30): the thumb travels on the critically damped `glide` spring, widens 5px under press (pointer button 0 + Space keydown, released on up/leave/cancel/blur), and gets a 1.16 scaleX wobble per committed state change (first render skipped). Reduced motion: transition {duration:0} to the same end state, no stretch, no wobble. Arms: `motion.span` + `animate()` from @humanspeak/svelte-motion; values from motion-tokens (`spring.snappy`).

bits-ui `Switch.Thumb` is intentionally not rendered: ARC hand-rolls a motion-driven thumb inside a `.track` span, so a plain span preserves DOM parity. The anatomy `thumb` part is recorded as unused.
